hero-bridges.use: Home hero background, from the nav to the next section break. The still (the loop's first frame) shows first and under reduced motion; the muted loop fades in after window load, with a visible pause toggle. 1080p by default, 1440p on large or high-density desktop screens, a 6:5 crop on phones.
hero-bridges.note: Stock time-lapse of the Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges, supplied by the operator at 1280x720, upscaled with AI to 3840x2160 (Topaz Gaia HQ on fal.ai, a non-generative enhancement) and looped with a 1 s crossfade. Not footage of BUZZY.
